data.long_description:
Experience modern living in this well-designed 1-bedroom apartment in Opalz by Danube, offering a spacious layout and premium finishes in a vibrant community.

Spanning 741.74 sq. ft., this apartment features a bright and open living area complemented by large windows that allow for plenty of natural light. The contemporary open-plan kitchen is fitted with quality finishes, seamlessly connecting to the living and dining space, making it ideal for both relaxing and entertaining.

The bedroom is generously sized with built-in wardrobes, while the property also benefits from two bathrooms, providing added convenience for residents and guests.

Property Features:

1 Bedroom
2 Bathrooms
Built-up Area: 741.74 sq. ft.
Open-plan kitchen and living area
Modern finishes throughout
Built-in wardrobes
Balcony with community views

Opalz by Danube offers residents access to a wide range of lifestyle amenities, including a swimming pool, fully equipped gym, landscaped areas, and recreational facilities, ensuring a comfortable and convenient living experience.

Ideal for both end-users and investors, this property presents an excellent opportunity in a growing and well-connected community.
